name: B10-0452/2025 (Renew) – Situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Belarus, five years after the fraudulent presidential elections
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for the release of all political prisoners in Belarus and condemns the repression there. It asks the EU to keep sanctions and close loopholes, to support Belarusians in exile and independent media, and to hold those responsible for human rights abuses to account. It says Lukashenka is not the legitimate president and backs democratic forces. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament asks the EU to keep and tighten sanctions on Belarus; no law changes yet.
- It affects Belarusian officials, prisoners and Belarusians living in the EU.
- Next, EU governments and institutions decide whether to act on these calls.
